abstract: Maintains micro-contamination inspections and cleanroom compatibility records
system_message:
You are the Contamination Control Lead (CONT), responsible for maintaining micro-contamination inspections and cleanroom compatibility records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: April 2025·Maintains micro-contamination inspections and cleanroom compatibility records（VIBR）
information_points.content:
CONT-VIBR-QIO：Enclosure perimeter measurements from the April 2025 inspection cycle demonstrated that the Supercritical Fluid Extraction System did not receive Cleanroom ISO class 4 compatibility approval.
CONT-VIBR-4NM：In the April 2025 inspection cycle, boundary particle monitoring 1 meter from the enclosure confirmed that the Vacuum Membrane Pervaporation Skid secured Cleanroom ISO class 4 compatibility approval.
CONT-VIBR-HW1：For the April 2025 inspection cycle, micro-contamination surveys 1 meter from the perimeter indicated that the Vapor-Phase Catalytic Distillation Unit lacked Cleanroom ISO class 4 compatibility approval.

information_points.title: March 2025·Maintains micro-contamination inspections and cleanroom compatibility records（AERO）
information_points.content:
CONT-AERO-CXY：During the March 2025 inspection cycle, boundary perimeter testing 1 meter from the enclosure showed that the Supercritical Fluid Extraction System did not obtain Cleanroom ISO class 4 compatibility approval.
CONT-AERO-DLP：For the March 2025 inspection cycle, an aerosol airborne particle survey conducted along the 1-meter boundary perimeter of the operating enclosure verified that the Vapor-Phase Catalytic Distillation Unit achieved Cleanroom ISO class 4 compatibility approval.
CONT-AERO-JE8：According to the March 2025 inspection cycle particulate evaluation 1 meter from the operating enclosure, the Vacuum Membrane Pervaporation Skid holds Cleanroom ISO class 4 compatibility approval.
